name: layout-guided-ai-imagen
description: A model-agnostic Codex plugin for sketch-guided AI image generation. The public workflow Skill is sketch-ai-imagen; the bundle ID remains layout-guided-ai-imagen for compatibility.

interface.shortDescription: Use @sketch-ai-imagen to control composition before AI image generation.
interface.longDescription: Use the public @sketch-ai-imagen workflow to review editable visual-framework candidates in a lightweight local canvas, confirm one atomically, and pass it with a complete creative prompt to a host image tool that accepts image inputs. The internal plugin bundle and MCP IDs remain layout-guided-ai-imagen for compatibility.
defaultPrompt: Never auto-select/confirm or generate images before a user selects and confirms in the workbench.
Open workbench and keep claim/wait active until user selects and confirms; default candidate A is not a selection.
Use @sketch-ai-imagen and runner prepare --session <id> --brief-file <json> to validate and seed candidates before opening the browser.
When MCP tools are absent, run bundled scripts/layout-guided-ai-imagen.mjs with the shared data root; never hand-write JSON-RPC.
Treat the confirmed canvas as broad layout guidance, not pixel/style replication; exact copy and explicit locks stay strict.
Run generation_preflight; stop on allow=false and use only server-persisted user_ui confirmation with supported image inputs.
